BUILD THE INDIVIDUAL: This necessary aspect of people management can often mean that we may ‘over task’ an individual, giving them work beyond their current skill set and outside of their comfort zone. We may accept sub-optimal performance in the ‘complete the task zone’ so that next time around we will have workers who are more highly skilled. BUILD THE TEAM: We have all been to team building events – some are great successes, some feel like an unwarranted distraction from the project life cycle. But the skilled manager will also be conscious of the smaller activities that can be built into the every day life of a project that go to build the team.
